verdict.rationale: Push-based MFA phishing defenses are a fair question for a 2FA product, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions push as a channel on the Twilio Verify page, a different, successor product. It never documents number matching, location context on push prompts, or admin-enforced MFA policies. Disabling new app installations and managing devices are adjacent user-level controls, not the requested phishing defenses.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
